title: Understanding Loss Functions
text: When considering loss functions, think about how they measure the difference between the predicted values and the actual values. Some functions penalize larger errors more than others. Consider how the exponent in the loss function affects this penalty.

title: Comparing Exponents
text: The Mean Squared Error (MSE) uses an exponent of $$2$$. If a loss function uses a higher exponent, it will penalize larger errors more harshly. Look for functions with exponents greater than $$2$$.
